name: bharosa_bank_loan_sales
title: Bharosa Bank Loan Sales
description: Extract the complete Bharosa outbound-loan sales schema, including customer details, locations, loan terms, customer questions, options and appointment checks.
notice: English-first fictional example, not real bank terms or financial advice. Infer agent/customer from conversation behavior, never from speaker number. Numeric output uses 0-9 digits; missing numeric values are null and missing strings are empty. PAN_card_digits means the last four characters, including the final letter. Translation/transliteration of non-English text is unsupported and flagged for review; original extracted fields are preserved. Number words and unfamiliar wording can be missed. Process only authorized transcripts and review all results.

fields.instructions: Infer the agent and customer from behavior, not speaker numbers. Did the agent greet the customer at the beginning of this outbound sales call?

criteria.Yes: The agent explicitly greets the customer in the opening

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior, not speaker numbers. Did the agent greet, thank or offer a polite farewell to the customer in the closing exchange?

criteria.Yes: An explicit agent closing greeting, thanks or farewell
criteria.No: No agent closing greeting, thanks or farewell

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Did the agent explicitly identify the company they represent as Bharosa or Bharosa Bank? A customer mention alone does not count.

criteria.Yes: Agent explicitly identifies themselves as representing Bharosa

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Did the agent check they were speaking with the intended customer and receive confirmation? Merely saying a name is insufficient.

criteria.Yes: Agent checks the intended customer's identity and the customer confirms

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Select the customer's explicitly stated full name, never the agent's name. Keep the original script. Select none if absent.
Use the selected customer name; Roman-script conversion is performed by output processing, not a second model question.
Infer roles from behavior. Select only the customer's explicitly stated date of birth, not an appointment or disbursal date. Preserve the transcript wording; select none if absent.
Normalize the extracted DOB to DD/MM/YYYY using Indian day-first convention; do not infer missing components.

Infer roles from behavior. Select the customer's PAN or the explicitly confirmed last four PAN characters. Do not select an unrelated ID. Select none if absent; output processing retains only the last four characters.
Infer roles from behavior. Select the customer's stated occupation or employment status, not an option merely offered by the agent. Preserve the original wording.
Use the extracted occupation in English; unsupported translation must be flagged, not invented.
Infer roles from behavior. Select the customer's employer or company, not the agent's lender. Preserve the original script; select none if absent.
Use the extracted company name in Roman script; unsupported transliteration is flagged.
Infer roles from behavior. Select the customer's years of work experience, not age or loan tenure. Do not calculate from dates. Select none if not stated in years.
Infer roles from behavior. Select the customer's explicitly stated salary amount, excluding turnover and loan figures. Preserve the stated monthly or annual basis; do not annualize or divide it.
Infer roles from behavior. Select explicitly stated business turnover, not profit, salary or loan amount. Preserve the stated period; do not calculate it. Select none if absent.
Infer roles from behavior. Select the six-digit pincode of the customer's current residence, not the permanent residence. Select none if absent.
Infer roles from behavior. Select the customer's explicitly stated current city, excluding PIN code or unrelated address information. Preserve the original script; do not infer from PIN.
Use the extracted current city in Roman script; unsupported transliteration is flagged.
Infer roles from behavior. What residence type is explicitly stated for the customer's current home? Do not infer from permanent-home ownership.

criteria.owned: Customer explicitly owns the current home
criteria.rented: Customer explicitly rents the current home
criteria: Not stated or neither option is established

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Select the pincode of the permanent residence. Reuse a current-address value only if the customer explicitly confirms both addresses are the same.
Infer roles from behavior. Select the customer's explicitly stated permanent city, not a hometown unless established as the permanent residence. Preserve the script; do not infer from PIN.
Use the extracted permanent city in Roman script; unsupported transliteration is flagged.
Infer roles from behavior. What residence type is explicitly stated for the customer's permanent home? Do not copy the current residence type without explicit confirmation.

criteria.owned: Customer explicitly owns the permanent home
criteria.rented: Customer explicitly rents the permanent home
criteria: Not stated or neither option is established

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Select the agent's final specifically discussed or offered loan principal. Prefer the final amount over an initial eligibility ceiling. Exclude EMI, salary, fees, insurance and customer-only requests not adopted by the agent.
Infer roles from behavior. Select the loan interest rate, not a fee, foreclosure percentage or insurance rate. Do not calculate it.
Infer roles from behavior. What interest-rate basis did the agent explicitly state for the loan? Do not infer it from the rate or EMI.
Infer roles from behavior. Select the final loan repayment tenure, not work experience, insurance coverage, or a lock-in period. Output processing converts explicitly stated years to months.
Infer roles from behavior. Select the explicitly quoted recurring monthly EMI for the final loan. Exclude fees and principal; do not calculate it.
Infer roles from behavior. Select the explicitly quoted processing fee amount. Do not add tax or convert a percentage into an amount; select none if no monetary fee is stated.
Infer roles from behavior. Classify the customer's final explicitly expressed interest in the loan, not the agent's enthusiasm. If no clear interest or refusal is established, choose Maybe.

criteria.Yes: Explicit interest or request to proceed
criteria.Maybe: Conditional, undecided, conflicting or unclear interest

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Select the amount the customer personally requests or explicitly expresses interest in. Do not substitute an agent-only offer or ceiling.
Infer roles from behavior. Did the customer ask how much loan was available or what the offered amount was? An agent volunteering the amount does not count.

criteria.Yes: Customer explicitly asks about the offered loan amount

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Did the customer ask about the total repayment or overall outflow across the loan, rather than only EMI?

criteria.Yes: Customer explicitly asks about total repayment or total outflow

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Did the customer ask about the EMI or monthly installment? Agent-only discussion does not count.
Infer roles from behavior. Did the customer ask how long the loan would run or how many repayment months there would be?

criteria.Yes: Customer explicitly asks about loan tenure

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Did the customer ask about visiting a branch or whether a branch visit was required?

criteria.Yes: Customer explicitly asks about a branch visit

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Did the customer explicitly express urgency or a deadline for needing the loan? Agent-created urgency does not count.

criteria.Yes: Customer explicitly states an urgent need or deadline

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Classify only the customer's expressed overall tone, not creditworthiness or suitability. Positive means clearly pleased or enthusiastic; Mild means mildly concerned or hesitant without hostility; Negative means clearly dissatisfied or hostile; Neutral means matter-of-fact or insufficient explicit tone evidence.

criteria.Neutral: Matter-of-fact or insufficient explicit tone evidence

fields.instructions: Select the explicitly stated life-insurance option details, including optionality and premium when stated. Preserve wording; do not infer coverage or purchase.
Select the explicitly stated health-insurance option details. Preserve wording; do not infer coverage or purchase.
Select only the explicitly stated Flexi Payment Reserve or FPR amount, not principal or fees. Do not infer product features.
Infer roles from behavior. Did the agent explicitly request and obtain the customer's consent for a CIBIL or credit-bureau check? Generic agreement to hear the offer is not consent.

criteria.Yes: Agent requests bureau-check consent and the customer explicitly grants it
criteria.No: Consent is discussed but refused or not obtained

fields.instructions: Select the explicitly stated part-payment rules, charges or timing. Preserve wording and do not invent terms.
Select the explicitly stated foreclosure or early-closure rules. Preserve wording and do not invent terms.
Select the explicit foreclosure charge percentage, not interest or another fee. Do not calculate a monetary charge.
Select the explicitly stated Broken Period Interest or BPI monetary amount. Do not calculate it or substitute the annual interest rate.
Use the extracted life-insurance details in English; unsupported translation is flagged.
Use the extracted health-insurance details in English; unsupported translation is flagged.
Use the extracted part-payment details in English; unsupported translation is flagged.
Use the extracted foreclosure details in English; unsupported translation is flagged.
Infer roles from behavior. Was an appointment with a sales or field manager actually scheduled and accepted by the customer? A proposed visit or vague follow-up alone does not count.

criteria.Yes: Customer and agent agree to a sales/field manager appointment

fields.instructions: Infer roles from behavior. Did the agent request or discuss documents required for the loan, such as ID, salary slips or bank statements?

criteria.Yes: Agent explicitly requests or discusses required loan documents
criteria.No: No agent discussion of required documents

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: Hello, good morning. I am Kavya calling from Bharosa Bank about a loan offer. Am I speaking with Arjun Mehta?

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Yes, my name is Arjun Mehta.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: Thank you. For this fictional demonstration, please confirm your date of birth and only the last four PAN characters, not the full PAN.

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: My date of birth is 05/08/1991. My last four PAN characters are 076L.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: What are your occupation, employer, work experience and income?

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: My occupation is salaried. I work for Example Technologies. I have 8 years of work experience. My monthly salary is Rs 85,000. My side business has annual turnover of Rs 12 lakh.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: Please confirm the current and permanent cities, pincodes and whether each home is owned or rented.

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: My current city is Pune. My current pincode is 411001. My current home is rented. My permanent city is Jaipur. My permanent pincode is 302001. My permanent home is owned.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: The initial eligibility ceiling is Rs 5 lakh. All figures in this example are fictional, not actual bank terms.

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: What loan amount can you offer? I am interested in Rs 3.5 lakh. I need it urgently by Friday. What is the EMI, what is the tenure, and what is my total outflow? Do I need to visit a branch?

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: The final offered loan principal is Rs 3.5 lakh. The interest rate is 18% reducing. The tenure is 36 months. The monthly EMI is Rs 12,653. The processing fee is Rs 3,500. Total repayment is Rs 455,508 excluding fees and optional products. A branch visit is not required. These are stated example figures, not a calculation or recommendation.

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: That sounds good. I am interested and would like to proceed with Rs 3.5 lakh. Please explain the optional products and early-payment terms.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: Life insurance: Optional life cover with a one-time premium of Rs 2,000. Health insurance: Optional health cover with an annual premium of Rs 1,500. The Flexi Payment Reserve amount is Rs 10,000. Part payment: Allowed after 6 EMIs with no part-payment charge. Foreclosure: Allowed after 12 EMIs with a charge of 2% of outstanding principal. Broken Period Interest is Rs 1,234.

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Thank you, that is clear. I have not agreed to buy either insurance option.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: May I have your consent to run a CIBIL credit-bureau check for this loan application?

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Yes, I consent to the CIBIL credit-bureau check.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: Please keep your identity proof, bank statements and latest salary slips ready. Can our sales manager meet you tomorrow at 3 PM?

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Yes, tomorrow at 3 PM works for the sales-manager appointment. I am pleased with the explanation.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: Thank you for your time. Have a good day. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Goodbye.
